consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1982-12-31 show at Oakland Auditorium Arena featured a solid performance, particularly in the third set with guest appearances by Etta James and the Tower of Power. While some reviewers noted issues with the sound mix, many praised the energy and overall enjoyment of the show.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 37 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance and guest appearances, there were notable criticisms regarding the sound quality and overall emotional impact of the show.
